+# are the flattened (verify token t, head h) pairs r = t * H + h, so a program
+# loads each KV tile of the request once for BLOCK_H rows and applies the
+# causal limit lim_r = min(L - qlen + 1 + t_r, L_real) per row. Splits
+# partition [0, max_r lim_r) identically in both stages. Partials and the LSE
+# are kept in the log2 domain inside the workspace; the final LSE is natural.
+# With a single split, stage 1 writes o / lse directly and stage 2 is skipped.
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+_LOG2E = 1.4426950408889634
+_LN2 = tl.constexpr(0.6931471805599453)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _verify_split_len(
+    L_split,
+    NUM_KV_SPLITS,
+    SPLIT_ALIGN: tl.constexpr,
+    MIN_SPLIT_LEN: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    # NUM_KV_SPLITS is a static upper bound (sized for cudagraphs); short
+    # requests use fewer, longer splits so tiny splits do not dominate.
+    per = tl.maximum(tl.cdiv(L_split, NUM_KV_SPLITS), MIN_SPLIT_LEN)
+    return tl.cdiv(per, SPLIT_ALIGN) * SPLIT_ALIGN
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _verify_tile_off(
+    pt,
+    start_n,
+    split_end,
+    stride_buf_kpbs,
+    stride_buf_kbs,
+    BLOCK_N: tl.constexpr,
+    PAGE_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    # Row offsets of keys [start_n, start_n + BLOCK_N); masked keys read
+    # nothing, so a tile past split_end is free.
+    offs_n = start_n + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)
+    mask_n = offs_n < split_end
+    kv_page_number = tl.load(pt + offs_n // PAGE_SIZE, mask=mask_n, other=0).to(
+        tl.int64
+    )  # page_number * page stride overflows int32
+    return kv_page_number * stride_buf_kpbs + (offs_n % PAGE_SIZE) * stride_buf_kbs
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _verify_load_tile_qsplit(
+    K_Buffer,
+    kv_off,
+    mask_n,
+    offs_d0,
+    offs_d,
+    offs_dpe,
+    HALF: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_DPE: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    # [HALF, N] K halves (QK operands), [N, 2 * HALF] V (PV operand, loaded
+    # in its own layout) and the [DPE, N] rope part.
+    k0 = tl.load(
+        K_Buffer + kv_off[None, :] + offs_d0[:, None], mask=mask_n[None, :], other=0.0
+    )
+    k1 = tl.load(
+        K_Buffer + kv_off[None, :] + HALF + offs_d0[:, None],
+        mask=mask_n[None, :],
+        other=0.0,
+    )
+    v = tl.load(
+        K_Buffer + kv_off[:, None] + offs_d[None, :], mask=mask_n[:, None], other=0.0
+    )
+    if BLOCK_DPE > 0:
+        kpe = tl.load(
+            K_Buffer + kv_off[None, :] + offs_dpe[:, None],
+            mask=mask_n[None, :],
+            other=0.0,
+        )
+    else:
+        kpe = k0
+    return k0, k1, v, kpe
+
+
+# Launch-varying ints are not specialized, so serving reuses the variants
+# compiled by warmup_decode_attention_fwd_verify.
+@triton.jit(
+    do_not_specialize=["stride_mid_ob", "stride_mid_oh", "BATCH", "NUM_KV_SPLITS"]
+)
+def _fwd_verify_kernel_stage1(
+    Q,
+    K_Buffer,
+    sm_scale_log2,
+    Req_to_tokens,
+    B_Seqlen,
+    Real_Seqlen,
+    Att_Out,
+    Out,
+    Lse,
+    stride_req_to_tokens_b,
+    stride_qbs,
+    stride_qh,
+    stride_buf_kpbs,
+    stride_buf_kbs,
+    stride_mid_ob,
+    stride_mid_oh,
+    stride_mid_os,
+    stride_obs,
+    stride_oh,
+    stride_lse_bs,
+    stride_lse_h,
+    k_scale,
+    BATCH,
+    QLEN: tl.constexpr,
+    NUM_HEADS: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_REAL: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_DMODEL: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_DPE: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_N: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_H: tl.constexpr,
+    NUM_KV_SPLITS,
+    SPLIT_ALIGN: tl.constexpr,
+    MIN_SPLIT_LEN: tl.constexpr,
+    PAGE_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+    Lv: tl.constexpr,
+    QSPLIT: tl.constexpr,
+    SINGLE: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    # 1D grid ordered (split, request, row block), row blocks fastest: the row
+    # blocks of one request run back to back and share its KV tiles through
+    # L2. The row-block count is constexpr so the decode needs no runtime
+    # division by it.
+    NUM_ROW_BLOCKS: tl.constexpr = (QLEN * NUM_HEADS + BLOCK_H - 1) // BLOCK_H
+    pid = tl.program_id(0)
+    row_block = pid % NUM_ROW_BLOCKS
+    group = pid // NUM_ROW_BLOCKS
+    cur_batch = group % BATCH
+    split_kv_id = group // BATCH
+
+    rows = row_block * BLOCK_H + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_H)
+    row_valid = rows < QLEN * NUM_HEADS
+    tok = rows // NUM_HEADS
+    head = rows % NUM_HEADS
+
+    seq_len = tl.load(B_Seqlen + cur_batch)
+    L_cap = seq_len
+    if HAS_REAL:
+        L_cap = tl.minimum(seq_len, tl.load(Real_Seqlen + cur_batch))
+    L_cap = tl.maximum(L_cap, 0)
+    lim = tl.minimum(seq_len - QLEN + 1 + tok, L_cap)
+    lim = tl.where(row_valid, tl.maximum(lim, 0), 0)
+
+    per_split = _verify_split_len(L_cap, NUM_KV_SPLITS, SPLIT_ALIGN, MIN_SPLIT_LEN)
+    split_start = per_split * split_kv_id
+    split_end = tl.minimum(split_start + per_split, tl.max(lim, 0))
+
+    # SINGLE (num_kv_splits == 1): o / lse are written here, rows without keys
+    # get o = 0, lse = -inf, and stage 2 is not launched.
+    if (split_end > split_start) | SINGLE:
+        q_row = cur_batch.to(tl.int64) * QLEN + tok
+        offs_d = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_DMODEL)
+        offs_q = q_row[:, None] * stride_qbs + head[:, None] * stride_qh
+        HALF: tl.constexpr = BLOCK_DMODEL // 2
+        offs_d0 = tl.arange(0, HALF)
+        if QSPLIT:
+            # Two half-width Q tiles: halves the LDS scratch of the Q layout
+            # conversion at large BLOCK_H.
+            q = tl.load(
+                Q + offs_q + offs_d0[None, :], mask=row_valid[:, None], other=0.0
+            )
+            q1 = tl.load(
+                Q + offs_q + HALF + offs_d0[None, :],
+                mask=row_valid[:, None],
+                other=0.0,
+            )
+        else:
+            q = tl.load(
+                Q + offs_q + offs_d[None, :],
+                mask=row_valid[:, None],
+                other=0.0,
+            )
+        if BLOCK_DPE > 0:
+            offs_dpe = BLOCK_DMODEL + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_DPE)
+            qpe = tl.load(
+                Q + offs_q + offs_dpe[None, :],
+                mask=row_valid[:, None],
+                other=0.0,
+            )
+        else:
+            offs_dpe = offs_d0
+        row_end = tl.minimum(lim, split_end)
+
+        e_max = tl.zeros([BLOCK_H], dtype=tl.float32) - float("inf")
+        e_sum = tl.zeros([BLOCK_H], dtype=tl.float32)
+        acc = tl.zeros([BLOCK_H, BLOCK_DMODEL], dtype=tl.float32)
+        ks = tl.load(k_scale)
+        pt = Req_to_tokens + stride_req_to_tokens_b * cur_batch.to(tl.int64)
+        if QSPLIT:
+            # Software pipeline: the next K/V tile is loaded before this
+            # tile's math and the block table is read two tiles ahead, so
+            # global latency overlaps the MFMAs (one wave per SIMD here).
+            nkv_off = _verify_tile_off(
+                pt,
+                split_start,
+                split_end,
+                stride_buf_kpbs,
+                stride_buf_kbs,
+                BLOCK_N,
+                PAGE_SIZE,
+            )
+            nmask = split_start + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N) < split_end
+            nk0, nk1, nv, nkpe = _verify_load_tile_qsplit(
+                K_Buffer, nkv_off, nmask, offs_d0, offs_d, offs_dpe, HALF, BLOCK_DPE
+            )
+            nkv_off = _verify_tile_off(
+                pt,
+                split_start + BLOCK_N,
+                split_end,
+                stride_buf_kpbs,
+                stride_buf_kbs,
+                BLOCK_N,
+                PAGE_SIZE,
+            )
+            for start_n in tl.range(split_start, split_end, BLOCK_N):
+                offs_n = start_n + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)
+                k0 = nk0
+                k1 = nk1
+                v = nv
+                kpe = nkpe
+                nmask = offs_n + BLOCK_N < split_end
+                if PAGE_SIZE < 8 and not K_Buffer.dtype.element_ty.is_fp8():
+                    # Two-tile block-table read-ahead spills VGPRs here.
+                    nkv_off = _verify_tile_off(
+                        pt,
+                        start_n + BLOCK_N,
+                        split_end,
+                        stride_buf_kpbs,
+                        stride_buf_kbs,
+                        BLOCK_N,
+                        PAGE_SIZE,
+                    )
+                nk0, nk1, nv, nkpe = _verify_load_tile_qsplit(
+                    K_Buffer,
+                    nkv_off,
+                    nmask,
+                    offs_d0,
+                    offs_d,
+                    offs_dpe,
+                    HALF,
+                    BLOCK_DPE,
+                )
+                nkv_off = _verify_tile_off(
+                    pt,
+                    start_n + 2 * BLOCK_N,
+                    split_end,
+                    stride_buf_kpbs,
+                    stride_buf_kbs,
+                    BLOCK_N,
+                    PAGE_SIZE,
+                )
+                if v.dtype.is_fp8():
+                    k0 = k0.to(tl.float32) * ks
+                    k1 = k1.to(tl.float32) * ks
+                    v = v.to(tl.float32) * ks
+                    kpe = kpe.to(tl.float32) * ks
+                qk = tl.dot(q, k0.to(q.dtype))
+                qk = tl.dot(q1, k1.to(q.dtype), qk)
+                if BLOCK_DPE > 0:
+                    qk = tl.dot(qpe, kpe.to(qpe.dtype), qk)
+                qk *= sm_scale_log2
+                qk = tl.where(offs_n[None, :] < row_end[:, None], qk, float("-inf"))
+
+                n_e_max = tl.maximum(tl.max(qk, 1), e_max)
+                safe_max = tl.where(n_e_max == float("-inf"), 0.0, n_e_max)
+                re_scale = tl.exp2(e_max - safe_max)
+                p = tl.exp2(qk - safe_max[:, None])
+                acc = acc * re_scale[:, None] + tl.dot(p.to(q.dtype), v.to(q.dtype))
+                e_sum = e_sum * re_scale + tl.sum(p, 1)
+                e_max = n_e_max
+        else:
+            for start_n in tl.range(split_start, split_end, BLOCK_N):
+                offs_n = start_n + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)
+                mask_n = offs_n < split_end
+                kv_off = _verify_tile_off(
+                    pt,
+                    start_n,
+                    split_end,
+                    stride_buf_kpbs,
+                    stride_buf_kbs,
+                    BLOCK_N,
+                    PAGE_SIZE,
+                )
+                k = tl.load(
+                    K_Buffer + kv_off[None, :] + offs_d[:, None],
+                    mask=mask_n[None, :],
+                    other=0.0,
+                )
+                if k.dtype.is_fp8():
+                    k = (k.to(tl.float32) * ks).to(q.dtype)
+                k = k.to(q.dtype)
+                qk = tl.dot(q, k)
+                # MLA reads V from the latent K tile.
+                v = tl.trans(k)
+                if BLOCK_DPE > 0:
+                    kpe = tl.load(
+                        K_Buffer + kv_off[None, :] + offs_dpe[:, None],
+                        mask=mask_n[None, :],
+                        other=0.0,
+                    )
+                    if kpe.dtype.is_fp8():
+                        kpe = (kpe.to(tl.float32) * ks).to(qpe.dtype)
+                    qk += tl.dot(qpe, kpe.to(qpe.dtype))
+                qk *= sm_scale_log2
+                qk = tl.where(offs_n[None, :] < row_end[:, None], qk, float("-inf"))
+
+                n_e_max = tl.maximum(tl.max(qk, 1), e_max)
+                safe_max = tl.where(n_e_max == float("-inf"), 0.0, n_e_max)
+                re_scale = tl.exp2(e_max - safe_max)
+                p = tl.exp2(qk - safe_max[:, None])
+                acc = acc * re_scale[:, None] + tl.dot(p.to(q.dtype), v)
+                e_sum = e_sum * re_scale + tl.sum(p, 1)
+                e_max = n_e_max
+
+        has = e_sum > 0.0
+        denom = tl.where(has, e_sum, 1.0)
+        if SINGLE:
+            tl.store(
+                Out
+                + q_row[:, None] * stride_obs
+                + head[:, None] * stride_oh
+                + offs_d[None, :],
+                (acc / denom[:, None]).to(Out.dtype.element_ty),
+                mask=row_valid[:, None],
+            )
+            tl.store(
+                Lse + q_row * stride_lse_bs + head * stride_lse_h,
+                tl.where(has, (e_max + tl.log2(denom)) * _LN2, float("-inf")),
+                mask=row_valid,
+            )
+        else:
+            offs_mid = (
+                q_row * stride_mid_ob
+                + head * stride_mid_oh
+                + split_kv_id * stride_mid_os
+            )
+            tl.store(
+                Att_Out + offs_mid[:, None] + offs_d[None, :],
+                acc / denom[:, None],
+                mask=row_valid[:, None],
+            )
+            # The LSE is computed after the tile store: the reverse order
+            # measured ~6% slower on gfx942 (16,8,32,16384).
+            tl.store(
+                Att_Out + offs_mid + Lv,
+                tl.where(has, e_max + tl.log2(denom), float("-inf")),
+                mask=row_valid,
+            )
+
+
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["stride_mid_ob", "stride_mid_oh", "NUM_KV_SPLITS"])
+def _fwd_verify_kernel_stage2(
+    Mid_O,
+    o,
+    lse,
+    B_Seqlen,
+    Real_Seqlen,
+    stride_mid_ob,
+    stride_mid_oh,
+    stride_mid_os,
+    stride_obs,
+    stride_oh,
+    stride_lse_bs,
+    stride_lse_h,
+    QLEN: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_REAL: tl.constexpr,
+    NUM_KV_SPLITS,
+    SPLIT_ALIGN: tl.constexpr,
+    MIN_SPLIT_LEN: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_S: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_DV: tl.constexpr,
+    Lv: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    # One (row, head) per program; BLOCK_S splits are combined per step so
+    # the loads of a step are independent (long split lists stay cheap).
+    q_row = tl.program_id(0)
+    head = tl.program_id(1)
+    cur_batch = q_row // QLEN
+    tok = q_row % QLEN
+
+    seq_len = tl.load(B_Seqlen + cur_batch)
+    L_cap = seq_len
+    if HAS_REAL:
+        L_cap = tl.minimum(seq_len, tl.load(Real_Seqlen + cur_batch))
+    L_cap = tl.maximum(L_cap, 0)
+    lim = tl.maximum(tl.minimum(seq_len - QLEN + 1 + tok, L_cap), 0)
+    per_split = _verify_split_len(L_cap, NUM_KV_SPLITS, SPLIT_ALIGN, MIN_SPLIT_LEN)
+    num_active = tl.cdiv(lim, per_split)
+
+    offs_d = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_DV)
+    offs_s = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_S)
+    base = q_row.to(tl.int64) * stride_mid_ob + head * stride_mid_oh
+
+    e_max = -float("inf")
+    e_sum = 0.0
+    acc = tl.zeros([BLOCK_DV], dtype=tl.float32)
+    for s0 in range(0, num_active, BLOCK_S):
+        sid = s0 + offs_s
+        mask_s = sid < num_active
+        off = base + sid * stride_mid_os
+        tlogic = tl.load(Mid_O + off + Lv, mask=mask_s, other=float("-inf"))
+        tv = tl.load(
+            Mid_O + off[:, None] + offs_d[None, :], mask=mask_s[:, None], other=0.0
+        )
+        n_e_max = tl.maximum(tl.max(tlogic, 0), e_max)
+        old_scale = tl.exp2(e_max - n_e_max)
+        w = tl.exp2(tlogic - n_e_max)
+        acc = acc * old_scale + tl.sum(w[:, None] * tv, 0)
+        e_sum = e_sum * old_scale + tl.sum(w, 0)
+        e_max = n_e_max
+
+    has = e_sum > 0.0
+    denom = tl.where(has, e_sum, 1.0)
+    tl.store(
+        o + q_row.to(tl.int64) * stride_obs + head * stride_oh + offs_d,
+        (acc / denom).to(o.dtype.element_ty),
+    )
+    tl.store(
+        lse + q_row.to(tl.int64) * stride_lse_bs + head * stride_lse_h,
+        tl.where(has, (e_max + tl.log2(denom)) * _LN2, float("-inf")),
+    )
+
+
+VERIFY_DEFAULT_CONFIG: dict[str, Any] = dict(
+    BLOCK_H=32,
+    BLOCK_N=16,
+    num_warps=4,
+    num_stages=1,
+    waves_per_eu=1,
+    matrix_instr_nonkdim=16,
+    kpack=2,
+    SPLIT_ALIGN=16,
+    MIN_SPLIT_LEN=256,
+    QSPLIT=False,
+    S2_BLOCK_S=16,
+    s2_num_warps=4,
+)
+
+
+def verify_row_blocks(qlen: int, num_heads: int, block_h: int) -> int:
+    return triton.cdiv(qlen * num_heads, block_h)
+
+
+def verify_num_kv_splits(
+    max_seq_len: int,
+    batch: int,
+    qlen: int,
+    num_heads: int,
+    sm_count: int,
+    block_h: int = VERIFY_DEFAULT_CONFIG["BLOCK_H"],
+    occupancy: float = 1.0,
+    min_work_per_split: int = 64,
+    max_splits: int = 8,
+) -> int:
+    """Static upper bound on KV splits (safe to bake into a cudagraph).
+
+    The kernel splits each request's own length into
+    max(cdiv(L, splits), MIN_SPLIT_LEN) chunks, so this only caps the split
+    count. ``occupancy`` is the number of resident stage-1 programs per CU.
+    If one split of every request fits in a single dispatch round, use as many
+    splits as fit in that round; otherwise pick n <= max_splits minimising
+    rounds(n) / n (the idle tail of the last round), preferring fewer splits
+    within 5% of the best.
+    """
+    programs_per_split = max(1, batch) * verify_row_blocks(qlen, num_heads, block_h)
+    ideal = triton.cdiv(max(1, max_seq_len), max(1, min_work_per_split))
+    slots = max(1, int(occupancy * sm_count))
+    if programs_per_split <= slots:
+        n = slots // programs_per_split
+    else:
+        cost = [
+            (triton.cdiv(n * programs_per_split, slots) / n, n)
+            for n in range(1, max(1, min(ideal, max_splits)) + 1)
+        ]
+        best = min(c for c, _ in cost)
+        n = min(n for c, n in cost if c <= best * 1.05)
+    return max(1, min(ideal, n, sm_count * 2))
+
+
+def decode_attention_fwd_verify(
+    q,
+    k_buffer,
+    v_buffer,
+    o,
+    lse,
+    req_to_token,
+    seq_lens,
+    real_seq_lens,
+    qlen,
+    attn_logits,
+    num_kv_splits,
+    sm_scale,
+    page_size,
+    k_scale=None,
+):
+    """Causal MLA verify over a per-request block table.
+
+    Args:
+        q: [B * qlen, H, Lk] queries, verify tokens of a request contiguous.
+        k_buffer: paged latent cache, [num_pages, page_size, 1, Lk] (or 3D
+            [num_pages * page_size, 1, Lk]).
+        v_buffer: k_buffer[..., :Lv] (V is read from K; only its width is used).
+        o: [B * qlen, H, Lv] output.
+        lse: [B * qlen, H] fp32 natural-log LSE (-inf for rows with no key).
+        req_to_token: [B, max_pages] per-request block table (not repeated).
+        seq_lens: [B] int32 kernel KV lengths L.
+        real_seq_lens: [B] int32 or None; row limit is
+            max(min(L - qlen + 1 + t, L_real), 0).
+        qlen: verify tokens per request.
+        attn_logits: fp32 workspace with >= B * qlen * H * num_kv_splits *
+            (Lv + 1) elements, laid out [B * qlen, H, num_kv_splits, Lv + 1].
+            Unused, and may be None, when num_kv_splits is 1.
+        num_kv_splits: static cap on KV splits per request (see
+            verify_num_kv_splits); shorter requests use fewer, longer splits.
+        sm_scale: softmax scale.
+        page_size: tokens per KV cache page.
+        k_scale: scalar tensor dequantizing an FP8 cache; ignored for bf16.
+
+    """
+    cfg = select_verify_config(q.shape[0] // qlen, qlen, q.shape[1])
+    Lk = k_buffer.shape[-1]
+    Lv = v_buffer.shape[-1]
+    assert k_buffer.shape[-2] == 1, "verify path expects a single latent KV head"
+    num_rows, num_heads = q.shape[0], q.shape[1]
+    assert num_rows % qlen == 0
+    batch = num_rows // qlen
+    if num_kv_splits == 1:
+        # Stage 1 writes o / lse directly; o only stands in for the pointer.
+        attn_logits, mid_strides = o, (0, 0, 0)
+    else:
+        assert attn_logits.shape[-2] == num_kv_splits
+        mid_strides = attn_logits.stride()[:3]
+    if k_scale is None:
+        k_scale = torch.ones((), dtype=torch.float32, device=q.device)
+    BLOCK_DMODEL = triton.next_power_of_2(Lv)
+    BLOCK_DPE = triton.next_power_of_2(Lk - Lv) if Lk > Lv else 0
+    assert Lv == BLOCK_DMODEL and Lk == BLOCK_DMODEL + BLOCK_DPE
+    has_real = real_seq_lens is not None
+    real = real_seq_lens if has_real else seq_lens
+
+    hip_kw = {}
+    if is_hip_:
+        hip_kw = dict(
+            waves_per_eu=cfg["waves_per_eu"],
+            matrix_instr_nonkdim=cfg["matrix_instr_nonkdim"],
+            kpack=cfg["kpack"],
+        )
+    grid = (verify_row_blocks(qlen, num_heads, cfg["BLOCK_H"]) * batch * num_kv_splits,)
+    _fwd_verify_kernel_stage1[grid](
+        q,
+        k_buffer,
+        sm_scale * _LOG2E,
+        req_to_token,
+        seq_lens,
+        real,
+        attn_logits,
+        o,
+        lse,
+        req_to_token.stride(0),
+        q.stride(0),
+        q.stride(1),
+        _page_stride(k_buffer, page_size),
+        k_buffer.stride(-3),
+        *mid_strides,
+        o.stride(0),
+        o.stride(1),
+        lse.stride(0),
+        lse.stride(1),
+        k_scale,
+        batch,
+        QLEN=qlen,
+        NUM_HEADS=num_heads,
+        HAS_REAL=has_real,
+        BLOCK_DMODEL=BLOCK_DMODEL,
+        BLOCK_DPE=BLOCK_DPE,
+        BLOCK_N=cfg["BLOCK_N"],
+        BLOCK_H=cfg["BLOCK_H"],
+        NUM_KV_SPLITS=num_kv_splits,
+        SPLIT_ALIGN=cfg["SPLIT_ALIGN"],
+        MIN_SPLIT_LEN=cfg["MIN_SPLIT_LEN"],
+        PAGE_SIZE=page_size,
+        Lv=Lv,
+        QSPLIT=bool(cfg["QSPLIT"]),
+        SINGLE=num_kv_splits == 1,
+        num_warps=cfg["num_warps"],
+        num_stages=cfg["num_stages"],
+        **hip_kw,
+    )
+    if num_kv_splits == 1:
+        return  # stage 1 wrote o / lse
+    _fwd_verify_kernel_stage2[(num_rows, num_heads)](
+        attn_logits,
+        o,
+        lse,
+        seq_lens,
+        real,
+        attn_logits.stride(0),
+        attn_logits.stride(1),
+        attn_logits.stride(2),
+        o.stride(0),
+        o.stride(1),
+        lse.stride(0),
+        lse.stride(1),
+        QLEN=qlen,
+        HAS_REAL=has_real,
+        NUM_KV_SPLITS=num_kv_splits,
+        SPLIT_ALIGN=cfg["SPLIT_ALIGN"],
+        MIN_SPLIT_LEN=cfg["MIN_SPLIT_LEN"],
+        BLOCK_S=cfg["S2_BLOCK_S"],
+        BLOCK_DV=triton.next_power_of_2(Lv),
+        Lv=Lv,
+        num_warps=cfg["s2_num_warps"],
+        num_stages=1,
+    )
+
+
+_VERIFY_SMALL_CONFIG: dict[str, Any] = dict(
+    BLOCK_H=32, BLOCK_N=32, num_warps=4, kpack=1, MIN_SPLIT_LEN=128, occupancy=2.0
+)
+# 64-row tiles, Q and the QK operand split in two 256-wide halves (QSPLIT,
+# which also enables the K/V prefetch), 32 keys per step on 4 warps. 8 warps
+# cap VGPRs at 256 and spill or idle MFMA rows here.
+_VERIFY_LARGE_CONFIG: dict[str, Any] = dict(
+    BLOCK_H=64,
+    BLOCK_N=32,
+    num_warps=4,
+    QSPLIT=True,
+    MIN_SPLIT_LEN=128,
+    occupancy=1.0,
+)
+
+
+_VERIFY_SMALL_MAX_ROWS = 640
+
+
+def select_verify_config(batch: int, qlen: int, num_heads: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Launch config from MI300X (gfx942) sweeps, bf16, page 16.
+
+    Few rows (B * qlen * H <= 640): 32-row tiles with more KV splits fill the
+    GPU. Otherwise 64-row tiles (Q split in two 256-wide halves, next K/V
+    tile prefetched) halve the KV re-reads per request.
+    """
+    cfg = dict(VERIFY_DEFAULT_CONFIG)
+    if batch * qlen * num_heads <= _VERIFY_SMALL_MAX_ROWS:
+        cfg.update(_VERIFY_SMALL_CONFIG)
+    else:
+        cfg.update(_VERIFY_LARGE_CONFIG)
+    return cfg
+
+
+def _storage_view(t, shape):
+    """Contiguous ``shape`` over ``t``'s storage, or a new tensor if too small."""
+    if math.prod(shape) > t.untyped_storage().nbytes() // t.element_size():
+        return t.new_empty(shape)
+    strides = [1]
+    for size in reversed(shape[1:]):
+        strides.insert(0, strides[0] * size)
+    return torch.as_strided(t, shape, strides, 0)
+
+
+def warmup_decode_attention_fwd_verify(
+    q,
+    k_buffer,
+    o,
+    lse,
+    req_to_token,
+    has_real,
+    qlens,
+    attn_logits,
+    sm_scale,
+    page_size,
+    k_scale=None,
+):
+    """Compile every launch variant serving can reach for these tensors.
+
+    A launch specializes on qlen, the row-count config and a single split, but
+    graph capture and profiling only run the full verify length. Each variant
+    runs once on scratch tensors with the strides of the real ones; the split
+    scratch reuses attn_logits' storage, whose size the launch specializes on.
+    """
+    num_heads, Lv = q.shape[1], o.shape[-1]
+    if attn_logits is None:
+        attn_logits = q.new_empty(0, dtype=torch.float32)
+
+    def scratch(t, rows):
+        return torch.empty_strided(
+            (rows, *t.shape[1:]), t.stride(), dtype=t.dtype, device=t.device
+        )
+
+    for qlen in qlens:
+        for batch in {1, _VERIFY_SMALL_MAX_ROWS // (qlen * num_heads) + 1}:
+            rows = batch * qlen
+            seq_lens = torch.full((batch,), qlen, dtype=torch.int32, device=q.device)
+            block_table = torch.empty_strided(
+                (batch, req_to_token.shape[1]),
+                req_to_token.stride(),
+                dtype=req_to_token.dtype,
+                device=req_to_token.device,
+            ).zero_()
+            for num_kv_splits in (1, 2):
+                decode_attention_fwd_verify(
+                    scratch(q, rows).zero_(),
+                    k_buffer,
+                    k_buffer[..., :Lv],
+                    scratch(o, rows),
+                    scratch(lse, rows),
+                    block_table,
+                    seq_lens,
+                    seq_lens if has_real else None,
+                    qlen,
+                    None
+                    if num_kv_splits == 1
+                    else _storage_view(
+                        attn_logits, (rows, num_heads, num_kv_splits, Lv + 1)
+                    ),
+                    num_kv_splits,
+                    sm_scale,
+                    page_size,
+                    k_scale=k_scale,
+                )

+import torch

+HIDDEN, INTER = 256, 128
+FP8 = torch.float8_e4m3fn
+NUM_EXPERTS = 4
+# Global ids of the experts _experts() places on this rank.
+LOCAL_EXPERTS = slice(2, 4)

+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def sm100_mega_moe_layout(monkeypatch):

+        "check_deep_gemm_mega_moe_supported",

+def _block_fp8(real: torch.Tensor, power_of_two: bool = False):
+    """Quantize ``(..., mn, k)`` to E4M3 with one float32 scale per 128x128."""
+    *lead, mn, k = real.shape
+    blocks = real.reshape(*lead, mn // 128, 128, k // 128, 128)
+    scale = blocks.abs().amax(dim=(-3, -1)) / 448.0
+    if power_of_two:
+        scale = torch.exp2(torch.ceil(torch.log2(scale)))
+    full = scale.repeat_interleave(128, -2).repeat_interleave(128, -1)
+    return (real / full).to(FP8), scale
+
+
+def _dequant_block(weight: torch.Tensor, scale: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    return weight.float() * scale.repeat_interleave(128, -2).repeat_interleave(128, -1)
+
+
+def _dequant_ue8m0(weight: torch.Tensor, sf: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    return weight.float() * torch.exp2(sf.float() - 127).repeat_interleave(32, -1)
+
+
+def test_requant_is_exact_for_power_of_two_block_scales():
+    torch.manual_seed(1)
+    real = torch.randn(1, 256, 256) * 0.05
+    weight, scale = _block_fp8(real, power_of_two=True)
+
+    requant, sf = requant_block_fp8_to_ue8m0(weight, scale)
+
+    # A finer power-of-two scale only shifts exponents, so nothing rounds.
+    assert torch.equal(_dequant_ue8m0(requant, sf), _dequant_block(weight, scale))

+
+def _experts() -> Glm5NextMegaMoEExperts:

+        compilation_config=SimpleNamespace(static_forward_context={}),
+    )
+    return Glm5NextMegaMoEExperts(
+        vllm_config,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+        num_experts=NUM_EXPERTS,
+        num_local_experts=2,
+        experts_start_idx=2,
+        top_k=2,
+        hidden_size=HIDDEN,
+        intermediate_size=INTER,
+        weight_block_size=BLOCK,
+        activation=MegaMoEActivation("swiglu", clamp=10.0),
+        num_shared_experts=1,
+        prefix="model.layers.3.mlp.experts",
+    )
+
+
+def _checkpoint(seed: int) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Block-FP8 experts as stored: gate rows, then up rows, for w13."""
+    generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
+
+    def rand(*shape):
+        return torch.randn(*shape, generator=generator) * 0.02
+
+    w13, s13 = _block_fp8(rand(NUM_EXPERTS, 2 * INTER, HIDDEN))
+    w2, s2 = _block_fp8(rand(NUM_EXPERTS, HIDDEN, INTER))
+    return {
+        "w13_weight": w13,
+        "w13_weight_scale_inv": s13,
+        "w2_weight": w2,
+        "w2_weight_scale_inv": s2,
+    }
+
+
+def _load_shuffled(experts, ckpt, seed, suffix="") -> None:
+    """Load the checkpoint tensors whose names end in ``suffix``, shuffled."""
+    shards = []
+    for expert_id in range(NUM_EXPERTS):
+        for name, tensor in ckpt.items():
+            if not name.endswith(suffix):
+                continue
+            if name.startswith("w2_"):
+                shards.append((name, tensor[expert_id], "w2", expert_id))
+            else:
+                half = tensor.shape[1] // 2
+                shards.append((name, tensor[expert_id, :half], "w1", expert_id))
+                shards.append((name, tensor[expert_id, half:], "w3", expert_id))
+    generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
+    for i in torch.randperm(len(shards), generator=generator).tolist():
+        name, loaded_weight, shard_id, expert_id = shards[i]
+        param = getattr(experts, name)
+        loaded = param.weight_loader(
+            param,
+            loaded_weight,
+            f"experts.{name}",
+            shard_id=shard_id,
+            expert_id=expert_id,
+            return_success=True,
+        )
+        # Physical experts 2 and 3 are this rank's.
+        assert loaded == (expert_id >= 2)

+
+def _reference_mega_moe_layout(w13, s13, w2, s2):
+    """CPU copy of DeepGEMM's transform_weights_for_mega_moe on packed scales."""
+
+    def interleave(t):
+        g, n, k = t.shape
+        halves = t.view(g, 2, n // 16, 8, k)
+        return torch.stack([halves[:, 0], halves[:, 1]], dim=2).reshape(g, n, k)

+    return (

+        utccp(interleave(s13.view(torch.int32))),
+        w2.view(torch.uint8),
+        utccp(s2.view(torch.int32)),
+    )

+def _expected_routed(ckpt):
+    w13, s13 = requant_block_fp8_to_ue8m0(

+    w2, s2 = requant_block_fp8_to_ue8m0(
+        ckpt["w2_weight"][LOCAL_EXPERTS], ckpt["w2_weight_scale_inv"][LOCAL_EXPERTS]
+    )
+    return _reference_mega_moe_layout(w13, s13, w2, s2)
+
+
+def _assert_layout(actual, expected):
+    for tensor, reference in zip(actual, expected):
+        assert torch.equal(tensor.view(reference.dtype), reference)
+
+
+def _routed(experts):
+    return (*experts.l1_weights, *experts.l2_weights)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("first", ["weight", "weight_scale_inv"])
+def test_weight_update_split_across_calls(first):
+    """A weight update may send weights and block scales in separate
+    load_weights calls. The finish step rejects a shard still missing its
+    other half and requantizes each shard once both are in."""
+    experts = _experts()
+    _load_shuffled(experts, _checkpoint(seed=0), seed=0)
+    experts.requantize_block_fp8()
+
+    ckpt = _checkpoint(seed=1)
+    second = "weight_scale_inv" if first == "weight" else "weight"

+        experts.requantize_block_fp8()

+
+
+def _shared_checkpoint(seed: int) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+    generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
+    w13, s13 = _block_fp8(torch.randn(1, 2 * INTER, HIDDEN, generator=generator) * 0.02)
+    w2, s2 = _block_fp8(torch.randn(1, HIDDEN, INTER, generator=generator) * 0.02)

+
+
+def _load_shared(experts, ckpt) -> None:

+    params = {f"mlp.experts.{n}" for n, _ in experts.named_parameters()}
+    for name, data in [
+        ("down_proj.weight_scale_inv", s2[0]),
+        ("gate_proj.weight", w13[0, :INTER]),
+        ("up_proj.weight_scale_inv", s13[0, 1:]),
+        ("down_proj.weight", w2[0]),
+        ("up_proj.weight", w13[0, INTER:]),
+        ("gate_proj.weight_scale_inv", s13[0, :1]),

+        loaded = experts.load_shared_expert_weight(f"mlp.shared_experts.{name}", data)
+        assert loaded in params
+
+
+def _expected_shared(ckpt):
+    q13, sf13 = requant_block_fp8_to_ue8m0(ckpt["w13"], ckpt["s13"])
+    q2, sf2 = requant_block_fp8_to_ue8m0(ckpt["w2"], ckpt["s2"])
+    return [t[0] for t in _reference_mega_moe_layout(q13, sf13, q2, sf2)]
+
+
+def _shared(experts):
+    return (
+        experts.shared_l1_weight,
+        experts.shared_l1_weight_scale,
+        experts.shared_l2_weight,
+        experts.shared_l2_weight_scale,
+    )
+
+
+class _Model(torch.nn.Module):
+    """Finishes a load the way the GLM model, wrapper and MTP drafter do."""
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.experts = _experts()
+
+    def process_weights_after_loading(self):
+        self.experts.requantize_block_fp8()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["layerwise", "direct"])
+def test_reload_requantizes_into_the_kernel_tensors(monkeypatch, mode):
+    """A reload writes the block-FP8 shards and finishes with the model's

+    record_metadata_for_reloading(model)
+    ckpt, shared_ckpt = _checkpoint(seed=0), _shared_checkpoint(seed=0)
+    _load_shuffled(experts, ckpt, seed=0)

+    # Already requantized shards are left alone by a second call.

+    _assert_layout(_routed(experts), _expected_routed(ckpt))

+    _assert_layout(_routed(experts), _expected_routed(ckpt))
+    _assert_layout(_shared(experts), _expected_shared(shared_ckpt))
+    assert {n: p.data_ptr() for n, p in experts.named_parameters()} == storage

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""GLM-5.3-Flash adapter for the DeepGEMM MegaMoE kernel."""
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.deep_gemm_mega_moe import (
+    MEGA_MOE_MXFP8,
+    DeepGemmMegaMoEExperts,
+    MegaMoEWeightSpec,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.mxfp8_utils import (
+    requant_block_fp8_to_ue8m0,
+)
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+# (local expert id, shard id); the fused shared expert has expert id None.
+Shard = tuple[int | None, str]
+
+
+class Glm5NextMegaMoEExperts(DeepGemmMegaMoEExperts):
+    """MXFP8 MegaMoE experts loaded from GLM-5.3-Flash's block-FP8 checkpoint.
+
+    The checkpoint stores E4M3 weights with one float32 scale per
+    ``weight_block_size`` block; the kernel takes power-of-two UE8M0 scales per
+    1x32. Loading writes each weight shard straight into the kernel layout and
+    stages its block scale in ``*_weight_scale_inv``. Once a load is complete,
+    the model's ``process_weights_after_loading`` calls
+    :meth:`requantize_block_fp8`, which rounds every newly loaded shard to the
+    kernel scales in place. The shared expert is fused the same way.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+        *,
+        weight_block_size: tuple[int, int],
+        num_shared_experts: int = 0,
+        **kwargs,
+    ):
+        self.weight_block_size = weight_block_size
+        self._num_fused_shared_experts = num_shared_experts
+        # Shards whose weight / block scale arrived since the last requantize.
+        self._new_weights: set[Shard] = set()
+        self._new_scales: set[Shard] = set()
+        super().__init__(vllm_config, weight_format=MEGA_MOE_MXFP8, **kwargs)
+
+    def _fusable_shared_experts(
+        self, shared_experts: nn.Module | None
+    ) -> tuple[int, MegaMoEWeightSpec | None]:
+        n = self._num_fused_shared_experts
+        return n, self.weight_format.routed if n else None
+
+    def _create_weights(self) -> None:
+        super()._create_weights()
+        e, h, i = self.num_local_experts, self.hidden_size, self.intermediate_size
+        self._register_block_scale("w13", (e, 2 * i, h))
+        self._register_block_scale("w2", (e, h, i))
+        if self.has_fused_shared_experts:
+            s = i * self.num_shared_experts
+            self._register_block_scale("shared_l1", (2 * s, h))
+            self._register_block_scale("shared_l2", (h, s))
+
+    def _register_block_scale(self, name: str, shape: tuple[int, ...]) -> None:
+        """Stage the checkpoint's float32 block scales of ``name``. The kernel's
+        ``{name}_weight_scale`` is derived from them and never loaded."""
+        *outer, n, k = shape
+        block_m, block_k = self.weight_block_size
+        scale = torch.zeros(*outer, n // block_m, k // block_k, dtype=torch.float32)
+        self.register_parameter(
+            f"{name}_weight_scale_inv", nn.Parameter(scale, requires_grad=False)
+        )
+        getattr(self, f"{name}_weight_scale").weight_loader_numel = 0
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _shard_rows(t: torch.Tensor, shard_id: str) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Rows of ``t`` (gate rows, then up rows, for w13) that hold ``shard_id``."""
+        if shard_id == "w2":
+            return t
+        half = t.shape[0] // 2
+        return t[:half] if shard_id == "w1" else t[half:]
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _shared_shard_id(name: str) -> str:
+        return "w1" if ".gate_proj." in name else "w3" if ".up_proj." in name else "w2"
+
+    def weight_loader(
+        self,
+        param: nn.Parameter,
+        loaded_weight: torch.Tensor,
+        weight_name: str,
+        shard_id: str,
+        expert_id: int,
+        return_success: bool = False,
+    ) -> bool | None:
+        local_expert_ids = self._map_global_expert_id(expert_id)
+        if weight_name.endswith("weight_scale_inv"):
+            param_prefix = "w2_" if shard_id == "w2" else "w13_"
+            loaded = bool(local_expert_ids) and param_prefix in weight_name
+            for local_expert_id in local_expert_ids if loaded else ():
+                self._shard_rows(param.data[local_expert_id], shard_id).copy_(
+                    loaded_weight
+                )
+            new = self._new_scales
+        else:
+            loaded = bool(
+                super().weight_loader(
+                    param,
+                    loaded_weight,
+                    weight_name,
+                    shard_id,
+                    expert_id,
+                    return_success=True,
+                )
+            )
+            new = self._new_weights
+        if loaded:
+            new.update(
+                (local_expert_id, shard_id) for local_expert_id in local_expert_ids
+            )
+        return loaded if return_success else None
+
+    def load_shared_expert_weight(self, name: str, loaded_weight: torch.Tensor) -> str:
+        """Load one shared-expert checkpoint tensor; return the parameter name."""
+        layer = "shared_l2" if self._shared_shard_id(name) == "w2" else "shared_l1"
+        suffix = "weight_scale_inv" if "weight_scale" in name else "weight"
+        param = getattr(self, f"{layer}_{suffix}")
+        param.weight_loader(param, loaded_weight, name)
+        return f"{name.partition('shared_experts.')[0]}experts.{layer}_{suffix}"
+
+    def shared_weight_loader(
+        self, param: nn.Parameter, loaded_weight: torch.Tensor, weight_name: str
+    ) -> None:
+        shard_id = self._shared_shard_id(weight_name)
+        if "weight_scale" in weight_name:
+            self._shard_rows(param.data, shard_id).copy_(loaded_weight)
+            self._new_scales.add((None, shard_id))
+        else:
+            self._load_weight(param.data, loaded_weight, shard_id, False)
+            self._new_weights.add((None, shard_id))
+
+    @torch.no_grad()
+    def requantize_block_fp8(self, chunk: int = 8) -> None:
+        """Round every shard loaded since the last call to UE8M0 1x32 scales,
+        in place.
+
+        Runs once a load is complete. A weight update may send a weight and its
+        block scale in separate ``load_weights`` calls, but both have to be in
+        by then.
+        """
+        unpaired = self._new_weights ^ self._new_scales
+        if unpaired:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"{self.prefix}: block-FP8 shards (local expert, shard; None is "
+                "the shared expert) loaded without their weight or block scale: "
+                f"{sorted(unpaired, key=str)}"
+            )
+        for shard_id in ("w1", "w3", "w2"):
+            experts = sorted(
+                e for e, s in self._new_weights if s == shard_id and e is not None
+            )
+            for start in range(0, len(experts), chunk):
+                self._requantize_shards(
+                    [
+                        self._shard_tensors(e, shard_id)
+                        for e in experts[start : start + chunk]
+                    ],
+                    shard_id,
+                )
+            if (None, shard_id) in self._new_weights:
+                self._requantize_shards([self._shard_tensors(None, shard_id)], shard_id)
+        self._new_weights.clear()
+        self._new_scales.clear()
+
+    def _shard_tensors(
+        self, local_expert_id: int | None, shard_id: str
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, ...]:
+        """Kernel weight, kernel scale and staged block scale of one routed
+        expert, or of the shared expert for ``local_expert_id`` None."""
+        if local_expert_id is None:
+            name = "shared_l2" if shard_id == "w2" else "shared_l1"
+        else:
+            name = "w2" if shard_id == "w2" else "w13"
+        tensors = tuple(
+            getattr(self, f"{name}_{suffix}").data
+            for suffix in ("weight", "weight_scale", "weight_scale_inv")
+        )
+        if local_expert_id is None:
+            return tensors
+        return tuple(t[local_expert_id] for t in tensors)
+
+    def _requantize_shards(
+        self, tensors: list[tuple[torch.Tensor, ...]], shard_id: str
+    ) -> None:
+        """Requantize ``shard_id`` of each kernel-layout weight in place."""
+        # A shard's layout destination is its checkpoint rows; the source is unused.
+        raw = torch.stack(
+            [
+                self._kernel_layout_shard(w, w, shard_id, False)[0].reshape(
+                    -1, w.shape[-1]
+                )
+                for w, _, _ in tensors
+            ]
+        )
+        block_scale = torch.stack(
+            [self._shard_rows(s, shard_id) for _, _, s in tensors]
+        )
+        # Power-of-two block scales requantize exactly; any other is rounded.
+        if not torch.equal(block_scale, block_scale.log2().round().exp2()):
+            logger.warning_once(
+                "GLM-5.3-Flash on the deep_gemm_mega_moe backend: the checkpoint's "
+                "%dx%d block-FP8 MoE scales are not all powers of two, so "
+                "requantizing them to MXFP8 (UE8M0 scales per 1x32) changes the "
+                "expert weights. Use another moe_backend to run the block-FP8 "
+                "weights as they are.",
+                *self.weight_block_size,
+            )
+        weight, sf = requant_block_fp8_to_ue8m0(raw, block_scale)
+        for (dst, dst_scale, _), w, s in zip(tensors, weight, sf):
+            self._load_weight(dst, w, shard_id, False)
+            self._load_weight(dst_scale, s, shard_id, True)
+
+
+Glm5NextMegaMoEExperts.weight_loader.supports_moe_loading = True  # type: ignore[attr-defined]

+

+    prefill, num_speculative_tokens + 2 tokens per request) takes the TRTLLM
+    prefill path and can be captured in a FULL CUDA graph. The graph keeps the
+    address of cum_seq_lens_q from capture time, so every build must write the
+    offsets into the same buffer instead of allocating a new tensor.

+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(

+            "layer.0": PerLayerParameters(
+                window_left=-1, logits_soft_cap=None, sm_scale=0.1, has_sinks=False
+            )
+        },
+    )
+

+        ),
+        head_size=vllm_config.model_config.get_head_size(),
+        dtype=vllm_config.model_config.dtype,
+    )
+    device = torch.device("cuda")
+    with set_current_vllm_config(vllm_config):
+        builder = FlashInferMetadataBuilder(
+            kv_cache_spec, ["layer.0"], vllm_config, device
+        )
+    query_len = builder.reorder_batch_threshold + 1
+
+    # Keep every build's offsets alive so a fresh allocation cannot reuse the
+    # previous address.
+    offsets = []
+    for num_reqs in (4, 3):
+        common = create_common_attn_metadata(
+            BatchSpec(seq_lens=[64] * num_reqs, query_lens=[query_len] * num_reqs),
+            block_size,
+            device,
+        )
+        metadata = builder.build(0, common)

+        assert isinstance(metadata.prefill, TRTLLMPrefill)
